const cashFailureOperations=new Set(['review-broker-cash-history','confirm-broker-cash-history']);
const cashFailureStages=new Set(['account-read','accepted-input-read','account-analysis','broker-cash-portfolio-read','broker-cash-review','broker-cash-confirm','broker-cash-confirm-analysis','account-save']);
function cashReviewFailure(message,{operation,stage}={}){
 if(!cashFailureOperations.has(operation))return null;
 const reason=cashInvariantLiterals.get(message),fingerprint=createHash('sha256').update('c1-cash-review-failure-v1\0'+message).digest('hex').slice(0,16);
 return {diagnostic:{contract:'c1-broker-cash-failure-v1',operation,stage:cashFailureStages.has(stage)?stage:'account-analysis',
  reasonId:reason?.reasonId||'UNCLASSIFIED_CASH_REVIEW_FAILURE',fingerprint},
  ...(reason?{error:'Brokerage cash verification failed: '+reason.literal+'. Purchases remain paused.'}:{})};
}
